description: Copy this file to a private qualification manifest and replace every example value.

servers.notes: Use an authenticated certificate and a fixture endpoint implementing the declared cases. Do not use credentials or query strings in endpoint URLs. Optional controls (template placeholders on h3.example.invalid, not evidence): stream_reset, graceful_connection_close, goaway_reconnect, alternative_port — each an https URL on the same authority without query or credentials.
A second non-Quinn implementation is required for graduation; this example is not evidence until executed.
Additional adapter diversity is encouraged; unsupported server-controlled cases remain explicit.
